nodes.label: Shared Supabase Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: The Supabase project is shared with other websites, so database work must be additive, use the megcredit_ prefix, and never affect unrelated objects or data.

nodes.label: Service Role Server Boundary
nodes.rationale: The Supabase service-role key must remain server-side and must never appear in browser code or VITE_-prefixed variables.

nodes.label: Staff Authentication Separation
nodes.rationale: Staff accounts use a separate table, session, and cookie so a client-authentication bug cannot escalate to staff access.

nodes.label: Encrypted Credit Monitoring Credential Exception
nodes.rationale: Clients deliberately submit monitoring credentials for staff report pulls; AES-256-GCM application-layer encryption and a narrowly scoped authenticated admin endpoint mitigate plaintext database exposure.

nodes.label: PDF Bureau Report Human Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Automated PDF parsing is best-effort, so parsed bureau data is withheld from the client portal until a staff member reviews and confirms it.

nodes.label: Direct Stripe REST Integration
nodes.rationale: Stripe is called through direct REST requests rather than the Stripe package to remain consistent with the project's Supabase and Resend integrations.

nodes.label: Less Decoration, More Meaning
nodes.author: Focus Labs Media Group
nodes.rationale: Visual design should prioritize trust, organization, hierarchy, whitespace, and meaning over decorative premium cues.

nodes.label: Navy Gold Ivory Brand Color System
nodes.author: Focus Labs Media Group
nodes.norm_label: navy gold ivory brand color system

nodes.label: Human-Centered Financial Imagery
nodes.author: Focus Labs Media Group
nodes.rationale: Clients should recognize their real lives in brand imagery rather than see fear-based scenes or unattainable luxury fantasies.

nodes.label: Pre-Render Theme Restoration
nodes.rationale: The saved light or dark theme is applied before application rendering to prevent an incorrect-theme flash.

nodes.label: No Guaranteed Credit Outcomes
nodes.rationale: Public information must not imply guaranteed score increases or deletion of accurate, complete, and verifiable negative information because results vary by file and third-party responses.

nodes.label: Protected Sensitive Document Channel
nodes.rationale: Credit reports and credentials should use a coordinated protected channel rather than ordinary email or the public contact form.

nodes.label: Canonical Public Source Guidance
nodes.rationale: Canonical website pages are authoritative and unsupported prices, credentials, locations, services, or outcomes must not be inferred.
